d:
Chirag pasvan ke bayan par tejasvi yadav ne do tuk javab diya aur apne andaj men palatvar kiya.
Tejasvi ne saph shabdon men kaha ki bat dur tak jaegi, jiske bad bihar ki siyasat men bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
